sheet.note: 4 mm ACP, 4′ × 10′ sheets; neighbouring sheets overlap ½″, so each covers 47½″

groove.note: ½″ bit: 3 mm deep in the ½″ where two sheets overlap (the joint), 1.5 mm deep for every other reveal line; the screws go in the reveals

patterns.name: Board look
patterns.note: vertical boards sized so a sheet's 47½″ of cover holds whole boards; the joint (the ½″ overlap) is a board line

patterns.name: Geometric lines
patterns.note: random straight lines across the whole wall, no two alike; sheet joints run plumb

patterns.name: Hexagons
patterns.note: pointy-top hexagons; sheets meet along hexagon edges (a zigzag joint)
